claims.claim_text: Henry L. Bretton transferred directly from U.S. Army Military Intelligence into the OSS Secret Intelligence section immediately after the war in Europe ended.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Immediately after the war in Europe ended, I was transferred from Military Intelligence (MIS) to become an agent in the Secret Intelligence section of OSS.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: Bretton's first-person account explicitly describes an immediate Military Intelligence-to-OSS Secret Intelligence transfer.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The first-person account is tied to the exact indexed person by the reproduced official Army citation and matching private identifier.
claims.temporal_assessment: The wording explicitly establishes Military Intelligence as the immediate predecessor assignment and dates the transfer to the end of the European war.
claims.match_notes: This is a military assignment, not a civilian employer. The source does not identify Bretton's last civilian employer before Army service.
